name: @pipeworx/mcp-pkg-go-dev

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List all published versions of a Go module by its import path (e.g. "github.com/gin-gonic/gin") from proxy.golang.org. Returns a sorted array of semver version strings.

tools.name: latest_version
tools.description: Most recent released version of a Go module — with the resolved time.

tools.name: get_module_info
tools.description: Metadata for a specific version (resolved version, commit time, origin).

tools.name: get_go_mod
tools.description: Raw go.mod contents for a specific version. Useful for dependency analysis.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pkg-go-dev forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pkg-go-dev pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
